description: GeoSkoru.com is Turkey's first GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) analysis tool, offering a free audit that shows how visible your website is in AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude. In just 30 seconds, you can test whether your site is being cited as a source in AI-generated answers. GEO is the set of technical and content strategies that make web content more visible in LLM-based search systems — and as more users turn to AI assistants instead of traditional search,
